Name: Raw Meat Chunk
Description: A chunk of raw, uncooked meat. Not very appetising, but it fills the stomach.

Name: Bone
Description: A sturdy piece of bone, useful for crafting or simple tools.

Name: BoneDust
Description: Finely ground bone dust, often used in alchemy or rituals.

Name: BoneChipping
Description: Small fragments of bone, often collected after carving.

Name: Tattered Animal Pelt
Description: A badly damaged pelt, with cuts and tears from an unskilled hunter. Not ideal.

Name: Animal Pelt
Description: A decent quality pelt, suitable for crafting clothing and other goods.

Name: Fine Animal Pelt
Description: A high-quality animal pelt, expertly harvested and in excellent condition. Highly valuable for crafting.
